g.text: Original synthetic teaching card • idealized timing • not measured engine data
1. Intake: piston down; intake open; mixture enters.
2. Compression: piston up; both valves closed.
3. Power: spark at top; both closed; gas expands, piston down.
4. Exhaust: piston up; exhaust open; burnt gas leaves.
One cycle = four piston strokes = two crankshaft turns (720°).
Connecting rod joins piston pin to crank pin throughout.
Illustration omits valve overlap, ignition advance, combustion detail and losses.
Qualitative reference: NASA Glenn, Four Stroke Internal Combustion Engine
